description: This file defines a base class for unit testing an IPC client in C++ using Google Test framework. It includes mock dependencies, shared pointers to mocks, and methods to set up and manage IPC client tests.

classes.name: IpcClientTestBase
classes.description: A base class for IPC client unit tests, providing mock objects and setup methods.

methods.description: Constructor for setting up the test fixture.

methods.name: ~IpcClientTestBase

methods.description: Initializes the IPC client for testing.
